summary: End-to-end regression for new 'duplas_rotativas' (Rei da Praia) tournament format. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases passed in /app/backend/tests/test_rotating_doubles.py — CompetitionTypeCreate accepts format='duplas_rotativas' (invalid format rejected 422); competition GET returns type_format='duplas_rotativas'; POST /rotating/draw-groups guards <4 and non-multiple-of-4 with 400 'múltiplos de 4'; with 8 seeded 'free' individual regs produces exactly 2 groups + 6 group matches (round 1..3, phase='group', group_id set, team_a/b ids+names present); GET /rotating/groups returns 2 docs each with 4 player_reg_ids & player_names; after scoring all group matches 6x3 the leaderboard is sorted desc, each of 8 players has matches=3 and points>=9 (i.e. team score is accumulated to every player of that team); /rotating/next-knockout-round before group scoring → 400 'placares da fase de grupos'; after scoring → creates 1 KO match phase='knockout', round=1; calling again while KO unresolved → 400 'placares da rodada atual'; after scoring the final → returns {finished:true, champions_registration_ids:[2 reg_ids]}; tenant B calling tenant A's /rotating/draw-groups → 404 (isolation OK); legacy 'individual' comp calling /rotating/draw-groups → 400 'não é do formato'; legacy 'duplas' /competitions/{id}/draw endpoint still works. Frontend: on /admin/competicoes/{id} of a duplas_rotativas comp, [data-testid='rotating-panel'] renders and classic [data-testid='draw-btn']/[data-testid='bracket-btn'] are hidden; click [data-testid='rotating-draw-groups'] renders 2 [data-testid='group-<id>'] cards each listing 4 player names and 6 group [data-testid^='rot-match-'] rows; filling scores + [data-testid^='rot-save-'] persists (winner auto-derived server side); after all 6 scored [data-testid='rotating-next-ko'] label='Iniciar eliminatória' is enabled; clicking it adds 1 KO match (7 save buttons total, 1 KO match on server, toast 'Rodada 1 da eliminatória sorteada'); scoring KO final then re-clicking next-ko shows toast 'Torneio encerrado!'; [data-testid='rotating-leaderboard'] renders 8 rows sorted by points desc.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py rotating_draw_groups deletes ALL matches/teams/groups for the competition on every call — this is destructive and there is a confirm() only on the frontend. Consider server-side guard: if any match already has a winner, require an explicit ?force=true query flag, otherwise 409.

GROUP_COMBOS_OF_4 shuffle only shuffles the regs list once (random.shuffle(regs)) — groups are then formed by consecutive slicing. It works for 8, but for edge cases like 12+ players a second shuffle within each group could produce more variety in seed matchups. Minor.

rotating_next_round: when len(qualifiers) is not a multiple of 4 (e.g., 6 winners moving to next KO round after 3 KO matches) it returns 400 'múltiplo de 4'. There is currently no handling for byes — for real tournaments with 6/10 qualifiers this will block the flow. Consider auto-bye or explicit user message + wildcards.
_rotating_leaderboard_data has no tie-breaker beyond points→wins→name; two players with identical stats will always sort by name — potentially unfair. Document or add head-to-head/point-difference.

RotatingPanel.saveScore does NOT send `winner` in PUT /matches — relies on server auto-derive. If a match is tied (score_a==score_b) server leaves winner=None silently, and `groupPhaseComplete` on the client will remain false with no visible error to the admin. Consider surfacing 'empate — defina um vencedor' or blocking equal scores in the input.

RotatingPanel next-ko button uses the group phase completion check purely from client-side state — after a hard refresh mid-tournament the state is derived from GET /matches which is fine, but there's no loading skeleton; the button briefly shows as enabled/disabled during initial load which could cause a race with an accidental click.

Registrations endpoint requires payment_status in ('paid','free') for draw eligibility. Free comp uses 'free', but if fee > 0 admins need to manually mark players paid — no error message tells them why draw returns 400 for a filled tournament with pending payments.

GET /rotating/leaderboard is UNAUTHENTICATED (public). This exposes participant names for any competition_id — probably fine for public tournaments but should be documented as a design choice, or restricted to logged-in tenant users.
test_credentials: Super admin danieloliveira78@gmail.com / ArenaHub@2026 used and not modified. Ephemeral rotA_*/rotB_* tenants + fe*_*/P*_* seeded regs cleaned up post-test.
seed_data_creation: Direct mongo inserts of 8 synthetic users+registrations (payment_status='free', mode='individual') for each backend flow test and for the frontend flow test — all cleaned up in fixtures/teardown (users, registrations, matches, teams, groups, competitions, competition_types deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite: `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_rotating_doubles.py -v -o addopts=''`. The test file loads /app/frontend/.env + /app/backend/.env explicitly and seeds registrations directly via motor (bypasses Stripe). Free-tier tenants have a 5-competition plan limit — tests split usage across tenant_a and tenant_b to avoid HTTP 402. mongosh CLI (not pymongo) is used inside the browser automation tool env because motor is not installed there. Frontend flow needs the admin to be actually logged in via /entrar prior to visiting /admin/competicoes/{id}; simply setting cookies is not enough because the SPA fetches /api/auth/me on mount. RotatingPanel.saveScore does not send winner, but server auto-derives it from score comparison.
